source_note: This is the public base commit, not a clean-source execution claim. The harness was added as uncommitted worker code; exact executed files and bundle hashes identify it. The later private WIP checkpoint is not a published release.

execution.scheduler_gpu_memory_note: Scheduler-sampled value; not guaranteed instantaneous peak.

torch_smoke.label: runtime smoke: numeric/training-stack check on a diagnostic linear model; NOT project policy training; no model weights downloaded or loaded
torch_smoke.model: torch.nn.Linear(128, 64) bf16, batch 32, AdamW lr=0.0001, seed 20261031

scene.model: LEAP Hand v1 Full right hand, fixed palm, hand-only scene (16 independent channels, no coupling equalities)

schedule.applied: row i at step i on CPU and on every GPU world
schedule.backend_representation: device ctrl dtype float32 on mujoco-warp 3.17: each frozen float64 row is converted by warp assign at every step; float64 precision is NOT claimed on the GPU
schedule.derivation: diagnostics.build_script filtered to sweep channels ('if_mcp', 'if_pip') plus spread/flex/open phases, gaps removed (durations and motion content unchanged); contains contact-free single-finger movement AND spread/flex phases that may produce self-contact

scene.world_variation: repeated_identical (backend diagnostic only; NOT randomized task generalization or training speedup)

source_and_asset_files_after_job.note: Post-job remote verification found only __pycache__/*.pyc differences; all source/assets and raw result hashes match. Future bundles must exclude generated bytecode.

limitations: Hand-only repeated identical worlds; no pad, GUI, policy training, model fine-tuning, randomized generalization or 8192 capacity acceptance.
PyTorch diagnostic Linear forward/backward/update is runtime verification, not embodied-trackpad learning.
GPU contacts and joints sampled world0 every20steps; all-world states every100steps; final samples included. No every-step all-world guarantee.
GPU solver warnings unavailable; not equivalent to zero warnings. CPU and GPU contact evaluation instants differ.
Self-contact penetration is reported, not a pass/fail gate; 28 recorded checks include disclosure-only entries.
Whole-loop 32-world throughput is ~5338 world-steps/s; worker quoted ~5549 by excluding observation time. The latter is not whole-loop throughput.
Cache size does not measure cumulative network downloads. The12GiB download budget could not be independently verified.
Local task-private macOS venv was created beyond the requested remote installation scope, preserved and frozen; subsequent review used existing runtimes.
Installation completed before fail-fast script correction; actual install success was checked from receipts and allocated-node runtime.
No further GPU job was submitted.
